header.note: BigInt values are quoted base-10 strings. f64 values that are exactly zero, NaN, or infinite are tagged strings ("0", "-0", "NaN", "Infinity", "-Infinity") because JSON.stringify cannot distinguish -0 from 0 and cannot represent non-finite numbers at all; every other f64 value is a plain JSON number, which both JSON.stringify/JSON.parse and serde_json round-trip bit-exactly via the ECMAScript shortest-round-trip algorithm.
